description: This file extends NodeAppModel with functions related to resolving and normalizing URLs for Canvas and A2UI hosts, managing UI connection states, and performing TCP probes, specifically for iOS platform integration within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: A2UIReadyState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the readiness state of the A2UI host connection.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Resolves the Canvas host URL, appending a specific path if valid and not a loopback host.

methods.name: _test_resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Test method to resolve A2UI host URL.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL, appending a specific path and query parameter if valid and not a loopback host.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by lowercasing scheme and host, and removing fragment for trust comparison.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the default A2UI canvas upon connection if needed.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures the A2UI is ready, attempting capability refresh if initial load fails.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Resets to default canvas on disconnect.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves A2UI host URL, refreshing node capability if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Resolves Canvas host URL, refreshing node capability if necessary.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to check host availability.
